title: Trump threatens 'unprecedented' economic consequences for any nation aiding Iran
summary: Trump declared "economic warfare" against Iran, warning that any nation or business providing a financial lifeline to the regime will face severe, unprecedented sanctions.

title: Jon Ossoff's controversial Trump jab sparks media feeding frenzy over White House aide Natalie Harp
summary: The viral jab against President Donald Trump by Sen. Jon Ossoff, D-Ga., during a campaign speech sparked a media frenzy over White House aide Natalie Harp.

title: Trump's approval rating plummets to new low ahead of critical midterms: 'More work to do'
summary: President Donald Trump's approval rating hits 33% in a new Reuters/Ipsos poll, and 80% of respondents expect the Iran war to go on indefinitely.

title: Ex-counterterrorism chief advocates for Trump to 'walk away from' Iran war, yank troops out of Middle East
summary: Former National Counterterrorism Center Director Joe Kent is advocating for President Donald Trump to get the U.S. out of the Iran war and remove U.S. troops from the Middle East.

title: Tim Walz accused of risking national security to defy Trump
summary: Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz's executive order blocking mining permits near the Boundary Waters drew sharp criticism from Tom Emmer, who called it "stupid."

title: Scandals, socialists and Trump roil primaries, send incumbents packing at near-record pace
summary: Republican Rep. Cory Mills joined 13 other incumbents ousted in 2026 primaries, one of the highest totals in decades, according to election analysts.

title: ‘Stripper’ Venmo ‘scandal’ makes Dems the punchline as Trump candidate flips script on viral DNC post
summary: Michael Alfonso turned a viral Venmo caption attack into a campaign fundraising blitz after conservatives rallied behind Sean Duffy's son-in-law.

title: Trump to nominate Dr Heidi Overton as next FDA commissioner
summary: Dr. Heidi Overton is President Donald Trump's pick to lead the Food and Drug Administration after Marty Makary resigned from the role in May following criticism from various White House officials.

title: Trump teases potential Kim Jong Un meeting later this year
summary: President Donald Trump says he expects to meet Kim Jong Un later this year, but North Korea rejected the idea of talks while praising the leaders' relationship.

title: Iran loses key economic lifeline in Middle East that Trump's sanctions couldn't reach as deadlock persists
summary: The United Arab Emirates suspended all trade with Iran after accusing Tehran of firing ballistic missiles toward maritime traffic in the region.
